account-scoped-storage-keys.$reason: Device-level by design: AgentHydra's web UI has no signed-in app account (a local dashboard over the same-origin daemon). agenthydra.app.view is the per-window tab choice, rebrandNoticePending a one-shot upgrade flag, and the usage-filter keys are display preferences over the whole account list. AgentHydra 2.0's window (desk2/web) and its copy of these pages (desk2/hydra) are the same single-user local window over the loopback server with no app sign-in: their agenthydra.* and hydra-desk* keys hold panel, width, layout, sort, filter, period, privacy-blur, dismissal and last-view choices, and hydra-desk-drafts names the composer's image-draft database. The same holds for the session list's filter choices (archived, source, dispatched, shape, rate-limited), the analytics source selection, the New screen's two project toggles, the dev-server snapshot (this machine's own servers, shown before the first fetch answers), the What's new marker and last-seen version, and the tasks panel width.

ime-composition-enter-guard.$reason: This repo has several files matching the default `/src/main.ts` suffix and only some of them are browser entries. `server/src/main.ts` and `orchestrator/server/src/main.ts` are Bun process entries - an argv dispatcher and an HTTP daemon, no DOM in their reach at all - so asking them to install a keydown guard is asking for code that could never run. The browser entries this suffix reaches, `orchestrator/web/src/main.ts` and `desk2/web/src/main.ts`, call `installImeCompositionGuard()` already (so does `desk2/hydra/src/main.ts`). The suffix is narrowed to `web/` directories; the rule is unchanged and still gates.
